top_signals.title: Bessent Plan May Be Short-Lived Remedy for Bond Slump
top_signals.summary: The global bond rally triggered by US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent’s plan to increase buybacks of longer-dated debt may prove short lived, with analysts citing persistent fiscal woes and sticky inflation globally.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: UBS’s Baweja Says Margin Pressure Is a Risk for Stocks in 2027
top_signals.summary: Strong US earnings growth should push stocks even higher before the outlook becomes less certain in 2027, with a risk that margins come under pressure, according to Bhanu Baweja, chief strategist at UBS Group AG.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Bitcoin ETFs draw $517M in largest one-day inflow since early May
top_signals.summary: Investors have poured more than $1 billion into US spot Bitcoin ETFs this week as BTC neared $72,000 and Ether climbed 19% to about $2,286 on Thursday.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.

top_signals.title: Amazon says it buys books in bulk to ‘improve products’
top_signals.summary: Amazon has said it buys books through commercial channels to develop its products after an investigation traced a bulk order of rare books to a facility where workers reportedly destroy and scan physical copies. “Amazon purchases books through commercial channels to help develop and improve the products and services our customers use,” an Amazon spokesperson [...]
